method: Fresh connected Drive metadata for 97 prior sources and scans of eight known parent folders. Four changed or new annotated PDFs reviewed visually across 178 pages against canonical PDFs and rendered guide content. Remote downloaded bytes match the local reviewed files by SHA-256. Private source text is not reproduced.
scope: Current annotated MH2100 Lectures 06-09. Earlier review snapshots retain their original scope and limitations.

files.evidence: Linearity, domain restriction, zero-area-overlap decomposition and polar bounds are already covered. Prior adopted coverage is preserved.
